def factor_downside_volatility_persistence(df):
    """Asymmetric volatility persistence: difference between downside and upside rolling volatility."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    pos_ret = ret.clip(lower=0)
    neg_ret = ret.clip(upper=0)
    upside_vol = pos_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std()
    downside_vol = neg_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std()
    factor = downside_vol - upside_vol
    df_copy["factor_downside_volatility_persistence"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_downside_volatility_persistence"]
